message: The briefing takes place before the workshop. The workshop takes place before the tour.
Mira left the blanket on the sofa. She put the cushion on the chair.
The river trail is shaded. The hill trail is exposed to the sun.
The ceramic bowl belongs on the upper shelf. The wooden tray belongs on the lower shelf.
The neighborhood garden welcomes visitors on weekends. Its tool shed stays locked.
The replacement handle fits the blue suitcase. It does not fit the green suitcase.
The west entrance leads to the courtyard. The north entrance leads to the lobby.
The wool coat must be cleaned by hand. The cotton jacket can be washed by machine.
The museum closes after the cafe. The cafe closes after the bakery.
Nora placed the scarf in the drawer. She left the umbrella by the door.
The east trail has shade. The south trail receives direct sunlight.
The glass pitcher belongs in the tall cupboard. The metal pot belongs in the short cupboard.
The reading room is open to guests in the afternoon. The archive remains closed.
The spare lid fits the round container. It does not fit the square container.
The side gate opens into the orchard. The front gate opens into the driveway.
The linen scarf needs to dry in the air. The polyester scarf may go in the dryer.
